# Vertigo Color

> Brazilian color grading studio for film, series, advertising and music videos, with live remote sessions.

Estúdio brasileiro de color grading e colorização de filmes para cinema, séries, publicidade e videoclipes, com sessões remotas ao vivo.

- Location: Av. Venâncio Aires, 907 — São Marcos, RS — Brasil
- Markets served: Brazil, United States, Europe, Saudi Arabia and India
- Clients include: Nike, Mercedes-Benz, Michelin, Natura, Mounjaro, R/GA, Verizon, Chilli Beans, National Geographic
- Founders: Germano Michelon Santos, Rafael Pereira Batista
- Contact: germanomichelonsantos@gmail.com · WhatsApp +55 (54) 99679-9638

## Projects

- [Dead Men Walk Alone · Violet Orlandi](https://vertigocolor.com/en/projects/dead-men-walk-alone.html): Music Video, color by Germano Michelon Santos. A gothic music video for singer Violet Orlandi: wine-red velvet, hooded figures and a palette that embraces the baroque without losing the skin tones.
- [Puto de Luxo · Xamã](https://vertigocolor.com/en/projects/puto-de-luxo.html): Music Video, color by Deisy Araújo. A music video for Xamã: black leather, cold light and high contrast. Grading that carries the video's attitude from first frame to last.
- [UCEFF](https://vertigocolor.com/en/projects/uceff.html): Institutional, color by Germano Michelon Santos. An institutional film on a helipad at sunrise: golden light, clean skies and a whole city waking up in the background.
- [Noug](https://vertigocolor.com/en/projects/noug.html): Commercial, color by Germano Michelon Santos. Product commercial for Noug: sand tones, clean packshots and a color pipeline built to make the product irresistible.
- [Taro / Blood, Milk and Sky · Violet Orlandi](https://vertigocolor.com/en/projects/taro-blood-milk-and-sky.html): Music Video, color by Germano Michelon Santos. A mashup of Taro and Blood, Milk and Sky for Violet Orlandi. Forest, blood and hard light — a video where color plays the role of wardrobe.
- [UNISC — Comunidade](https://vertigocolor.com/en/projects/unisc.html): Commercial, color by Germano Michelon Santos. A UNISC campaign across dozens of locations — construction site, kitchen, pool, hospital, library — with one clear challenge: making every light source speak the same language.
- [My Voice for You · Spektra](https://vertigocolor.com/en/projects/my-voice-for-you.html): Music Video, color by Germano Michelon Santos. A black-and-white music video for the band Spektra. Nowhere to hide without color: the work here is contrast, texture and silver density.
- [Metagenics](https://vertigocolor.com/en/projects/metagenics.html): Commercial, color by Jana Spínola. A beauty and wellness commercial on pure black: skin as the absolute protagonist, with grading precise enough to survive extreme close-ups.
- [Call Me (Blondie cover) · Violet Orlandi](https://vertigocolor.com/en/projects/call-me.html): Music Video, color by Jana Spínola. An acoustic cover of Blondie's Call Me in studio black-and-white — fine grain and grays with personality.
- [Only Holy Water (Acoustic) · Violet Orlandi](https://vertigocolor.com/en/projects/only-holy-water.html): Music Video, color by Jana Spínola. An acoustic session in an autumn room: wood, an apple tree and a warm, film-stock palette.
